# CI and dependency verification gate

**Status:** Lockfile generated by GitHub Actions bootstrap and committed on the feature branch. `npm ci`, TypeScript check, and Vite production build were prerequisites of the bootstrap commit. The normal PR workflow must also pass after this change.

## Completed on this branch
- [x] Generated `package-lock.json` from `package.json` on GitHub-hosted runner.
- [x] Bootstrap ran `npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund`, `npm run check`, and `npm run build` before committing the lockfile.
- [x] Updated normal CI workflow to use `npm ci` instead of floating `npm install`.
- [x] Deleted the temporary workflow with `contents: write` permission.

## Still required before deployment
- [ ] Confirm normal PR check passes and review resolved versions, license compatibility and advisories in the lockfile.
- [ ] Pin GitHub Actions by immutable SHA and review action dependencies.
- [ ] Add lint, test, automated dependency/advisory analysis, and browser tests.
- [ ] Add installability icons, then evaluate service worker only after its cache/update security policy.
- [ ] Confirm no build-time secrets are embedded in static assets.
- [ ] Test CSP, E2EE, HTTPS, key lifecycle, and security on real mobile browsers.

CI passing is **not** a security certification or approval for real confidential messages.
